thesis: The episode explores the convergence of AI and crypto, framing them as natural counterweights where AI enables top-down centralized control and crypto enables bottom-up decentralized cooperation. The discussion also examines how blockchain and zero-knowledge proofs could allow individuals to own and control long-running AI models, while addressing challenges like data privacy and the need to prove humanity in an era of deepfakes.
